notes: I rewrote the counter-advance rule: the old global-parity model failed on E5 (and E3/E4). The new rule is "a capable action advances unless it repeats the action that just advanced, and the very first action of a level never advances" — this fits E1–E5 except E2's ACTION4. I also fixed the target-block position (block start = click y − 1, giving rows 49-51/54-56/59-61) and modeled the click colour
